cards.answer: Poppy is a tank/fighter who stops nearby dashes and pushes enemies into walls to stun them. Her hammer abilities deal physical damage, while her defenses benefit from health, armor and magic resistance.
cards.counterplay: Keep away from wall angles and avoid dashing through her active dash-stopping aura.

cards.answer: Poppy periodically makes a longer-range buckler attack that deals bonus magic damage. She can retrieve the dropped buckler for a temporary shield; enemy champions can step on it to destroy it. If the attack kills its target, the buckler returns to her automatically.
cards.counterplay: Step on the dropped buckler when safe to deny her shield.

cards.answer: Hammer Shock deals physical damage based partly on the target's maximum health. It leaves a slowing field that ruptures after a delay, dealing the same damage again.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the field before it ruptures.

cards.answer: Steadfast Presence passively increases Poppy's armor and magic resistance, with a stronger bonus at low health. Activating it grants movement speed and creates an aura that stops enemy dashes, dealing magic damage and briefly knocking enemies up. Successfully interrupted enemies are then slowed and grounded.
cards.counterplay: Avoid dashing into or within the aura; wait for it to expire before committing mobility.

citations.quote: Passive: Poppy increases her total armor and total magic resist. This effect is doubled while she is at low health.

cards.answer: Heroic Charge makes Poppy dash to an enemy, dealing physical damage and pushing them forward. If she pushes them into terrain, they take the same damage again and are stunned.
cards.counterplay: Avoid positioning with terrain behind you relative to Poppy.

cards.answer: Keeper's Verdict released without charging deals physical damage and briefly knocks up enemies nearby and in front of Poppy. Charging it increases its range and knockback distance; the charged strike deals more physical damage and knocks enemies toward their own fountain. Enemies displaced by the charged strike are untargetable during the knockback.
cards.counterplay: Move away from her firing line or interrupt her charge when possible.
